results.statement: atm-bd must show a sanity runs page and a quality runs page, newest run on top, one line per run; the sanity line must carry a pass/fail column and an elapsed-time column for JEV and for LLM each, and a column with the name and nerd icon of the dev whose work was checked; elapsed comes from the Jev client's own return and from a timer fenced around the LLM subagent, and the same rows feed the OTel database in the next atm release.
results.quote: sanity agent never does it and I always need to ask.  it is the only thing I want to see from sanity agent.  perhaps we should consider adding a tui page for both sanity and quality which showed the runs sorted by most recent (on top).  the sanity page would have 1 line per run and both jev + llm would have columns for pass/fail AND elapsed time (which is currently not calculated properly).  Regarding calculation, can't this be returned from the jev.py method call and a timer fencing around the llm agent?  I would also like to have a column for what dev (name and nerd icon) did the work under review.  This would remove the agent distraction and show the data I want to see (and get into otel db on next atm release).
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18 (third round): Rand on the sanity runs table, Jev/LLM failures and refusal ceremony
results.deterministic_check: the console has a sanity page and a quality page; a ledger row has jev_elapsed_s, llm_elapsed_s and dev fields; jev_client.py returns elapsed; the dev-sanity prompt wraps the LLM spawn in a start/end time; the sanity reply template no longer renders the runs table
